title: What drives a car that can drive itself? Qnity innovation.
summary: On the autonomous road ahead, Qnity(formerly DuPont Electronics) is helping catalyze a more sustainable world. With materials that vastly improve connectivity, reliability and processing speed.
body_markdown:
When it comes to transportation, the future is electric. Next generation emobility vehicles rely on advanced interconnects to facilitate everything from safety controls to powertrain performance to passenger comfort.


This video provides you an overview of how Qnity(formerly DuPont Electronics) electronic materials help partners to create solutions that perform more reliably, more comfortably, and more connected. As an industry leader, Qnity(formerly DuPont Electronics) can help you solve tomorrow’s challenges today and reach your destination.
